question: Why did the error rate go up on 04 March 2026?

contributing_factors.description: New deployment of auth v2.14 caused the error rate to spike.
why_chain: auth v2.14 deployment introduced a new version of the RequestHandler.
NullPointerException in RequestHandler.serialize (v2.14) led to errors.
Increased error rate observed in service auth in region us-east.

ruled_out.hypothesis: Increased error rate due to a sudden surge in traffic.
ruled_out.reason: Request volume and latency stayed about the same.

ruled_out.hypothesis: Error rate spike caused by a different deployment.
ruled_out.reason: Deployed search v8.0 to eu-west 9 minutes before the change.

ruled_out.hypothesis: No significant changes in request volume or latency.
ruled_out.reason: It rests on a change that is too early, or in a different service/region, to explain a sudden change here.

evidence.summary: Error rate for service auth in region us-east rose from 0.38% to 3.71% (+880%), with a change point at 2026-03-04T04:55:00Z.
The change is concentrated in service auth in region us-east: 1 of 12 service/region segments changed; the other segments stayed flat (largest after/before ratio 1.08).
At the same time, request volume for service auth in region us-east stayed about the same (490 per 5 min before, 564 per 5 min after, +15%).
At the same time, p95 latency for service auth in region us-east stayed about the same (90 ms before, 90 ms after, -0%).
Deployed auth v2.14 to us-east (auth, us-east; 8 min before the change; record R010; fit: right time and place: a strong candidate cause)
High error rate on auth in us-east (auth, us-east; 5 min after the change; record R012; fit: describes a symptom, not a change)
auth: ERROR NullPointerException in RequestHandler.serialize (v2.14) (auth, us-east; 3 min after the change; record R011; fit: describes a symptom, not a change)
auth: ERROR NullPointerException in RequestHandler.serialize (v2.14) (auth, us-east; 22 min after the change; record R013; fit: after the change, so a symptom, not a cause)
Deployed search v8.0 to eu-west (search, eu-west; 9 min before the change; record R009; fit: different service/region, so unlikely to be the cause)

reasons: ✓ A change event (deploys) lines up in time (8 min before the change).
✓ 3 log/alert record(s) after the change agree with the numbers.
✓ Request volume stayed steady, ruling out a traffic spike.
✓ No competing change event fits as well.
✓ The main factor rests on this event.

actions.action: Roll back the auth v2.14 deployment to mitigate the error rate spike.
Review and test the RequestHandler in v2.14 to identify and fix the NullPointerException.
Monitor the error rate closely and implement a fallback mechanism for the RequestHandler in v2.14.
